meta.boundaries_source: NYC community district boundaries, NYC Department of City Planning (NYC Open Data), retrieved via the NYC EH Data Portal geography mirror at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nycehs/NYC_geography/master/CD.geo.json
meta.indicator_source: NYC Council Data Team analysis of the NYC Human Resources Administration Borough/Community District Report and NYC Department of City Planning 2020 Census population
meta.geography_level: community district (NTA and ZIP-level rates were not reachable from the build environment)
meta.simplification: Douglas-Peucker at 0.00012 degrees, coordinates rounded to 5 decimals
meta.note: snap is the published rate, multiplied by 100 and rounded to one decimal. Nothing is interpolated, blended or estimated; districts the source does not cover carry snap:null.
